propositions: Dense multi-criterion completion runs exhaust the bounded request budget without banking any criterion verdicts, violating the incremental banking contract and raising CompletionRecoveryError instead of returning evidence-backed PASS/FAIL.
Pydantic AI executes a model response's tool batch concurrently, making prompt-only instructions insufficient to serialize repository evidence calls and enforce one record action per response.

The finite-loop banking enforcement must move from untrusted ticket context to an authoritative system-level completion-only wrapper that claims one governed action per response and invokes provisional met=false on the third evidence response if still unbanked.

A private metadata contract via _rebar_completion_evidence_policy dataclass attaches a per-criterion boundary detector and fallback record callable to the record tool, enabling atomic progress before request exhaustion without schema or API changes.
